name: Arsenic
health_effects: Long-term exposure causes arsenicosis: dark skin lesions, hardened patches on palms and soles, and a raised risk of skin, lung and bladder cancer, plus cardiovascular and developmental harm. Effects build up silently over years.
removal: Reverse osmosis (RO), activated alumina, or iron-based adsorbent filters. Boiling does NOT remove arsenic and concentrates it as water evaporates.

name: Fluoride
health_effects: Above ~1.5 mg/L causes dental fluorosis (mottled, brown-stained teeth) in children; sustained high intake causes skeletal fluorosis — stiff, painful joints and, in severe cases, crippling bone deformities.
removal: Activated alumina filters, RO, or the Nalgonda technique. Boiling does NOT remove fluoride.

name: Nitrate
health_effects: High nitrate causes methaemoglobinaemia ('blue baby syndrome') in bottle-fed infants — the blood cannot carry oxygen properly, which can be fatal. Linked to thyroid effects and possible cancer risk with long exposure. Mainly from fertiliser runoff and sewage.
removal: RO or ion-exchange filters. Boiling does NOT remove nitrate and concentrates it — never prepare infant formula with boiled high-nitrate water.

name: Uranium
health_effects: Chemically (not mainly via radiation) toxic to the kidneys; long-term exposure can impair kidney function and affect bone. Emerging as a major contaminant in Rajasthan and Punjab from geology plus heavy groundwater extraction and fertiliser use.
removal: RO or ion-exchange. Boiling does NOT remove uranium.

name: Iron
health_effects: Mostly an aesthetic problem — metallic taste, reddish-brown staining of vessels and clothes — but very high levels cause stomach upset and can signal other groundwater quality issues. Common across the North-East and eastern India.
removal: Aeration followed by filtration, or oxidation-based iron-removal units. Boiling does NOT remove iron.

name: Salinity / High TDS
health_effects: Very high dissolved salts make water taste brackish and can worsen hypertension, contribute to kidney stones, and cause stomach upset. Common in arid Rajasthan/Gujarat and coastal aquifers facing seawater intrusion.
vulnerable: people with hypertension or kidney conditions
removal: Reverse osmosis (RO) is the only practical home option. Boiling does NOT reduce dissolved salts.

name: Heavy metals (lead, cadmium, chromium)
health_effects: Industrial heavy-metal contamination is serious: lead is neurotoxic and lowers children's IQ, cadmium damages kidneys and bones, and chromium (VI) is carcinogenic. Found in pockets near industrial and tannery belts.
removal: RO plus activated-carbon filtration. Boiling does NOT remove heavy metals.
